name: io.github.sourav2024/technical-seo
description: Audit websites for technical and on-page SEO: crawlability, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals, sitemap, robots.txt, structured data, keyword placement, and AI-crawler access. Reports as Markdown, JSON, or a shareable HTML file.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: silent, error, warn, info (default), or debug. Logs go to stderr only.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Log shape: json (default, one object per line) or text (human-readable).

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where per-target baselines and fallback HTML reports are stored. Defaults to the OS state directory.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (1000-120000). Raise for slow sites.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_CRAWL_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Politeness delay between crawled pages in milliseconds (0-60000).

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_CRAWL_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Parallel page fetches during a crawl (1-8). Raise only for sites you own.

environmentVariables.name: SEO_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Allow auditing localhost and private IP ranges. Defaults to true so local dev servers work; set to false to enable SSRF protection when URLs come from untrusted input.

environmentVariables.name: CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Chrome/Chromium/Edge binary. Auto-detected when unset; only run_lighthouse needs it.
